components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On read this is the composed, normalized address (addressLine1, plus a space and addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured address (street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; supply this or 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured address (unit, suite, etc.).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner, stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-02'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: Optional date of birth of the pet owner. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household).
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created owner; set true by DELETE, which retains the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, e.g. 'J.S.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the region code, the 2-digit fiscal year, the 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>', e.g. 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is numbered by its ending calendar year, e.g. 'FY27' for 1 July 2026 - 30 June 2027.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by all owners at the same last name and address (a household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key, 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email empty when absent); two owners are duplicates only when their whole keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive), counted just before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points - starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The region derived from the owner's city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone derived from the owner's region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); absent for any other region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created today (by registration date), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

## What I changed

The spec adds a derived `riskFlag` boolean to the owner response, true when **any** of three conditions hold. Two of the three inputs are *already computed* in `RespondWithOwner.service` — `possibleDuplicateOf` and `capacityWarning` — so I reused them rather than recomputing.

**Two files touched:**

1. `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — declared the `riskFlag` schema field on the owner DTO (generates `getRiskFlag`/`setRiskFlag`), mirroring the existing `capacityWarning`/`possibleDuplicate` derived fields.

2. `.../rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwner.java` — one new line in `service` sets the flag by OR-ing the two already-computed signals with a new disposable-adjacent check, plus a small private `disposableAdjacent(email)` helper.

## Mapping to the spec
- **possible duplicate** → `possibleDuplicateOf != null` (reuses `PossibleDuplicate`).
- **city over soft capacity** → `capacityWarning` (reuses `CapacityWarning`, the 40–49 approaching-limit flag).
- **email domain disposable-adjacent** → domain equals a known disposable domain or is a subdomain of one (`endsWith("." + d)`). Exact disposable domains are rejected at create by `NormalizeOwnerEmail`, so on a saved owner this catches the subdomain "adjacent" cases that slip through.

## Structural impact
I kept `RespondWithOwner`'s only orchestration method simple (the risk logic is a single expression delegating to the small helper), reused two existing computations instead of adding new pipeline steps, and touched no other classes. The acceptance test (`riskFlag` false for a normal structured owner) and the full suite pass.
